title: 214. Extra Characters in a String

examples.explanation: We can break s in two substrings: "leet" from index 0 to 3 and "code" from index 5 to 8. There is only 1 unused character (at index 4), so we return 1.

We can break s in two substrings: "hello" from index 3 to 7 and "world" from index 8 to 12. The characters at indices 0, 1, 2 are not used in any substring and thus are considered as extra characters. Hence, we return 3.

hints: Can we use Dynamic Programming here?

Define dp[i] as the minimum number of extra characters if breaking up s[i:] optimally: either s[i] is unused (one extra character plus dp[i+1]) or it starts a dictionary word of some length len, giving dp[i + len].
A trie of the dictionary lets every word starting at the same position be found in one pass instead of re-scanning all dictionary entries at every index.
